conviction_note: Mostly a non-result: a Q1 of a seasonal May-FY name with no H1 guide, no revision expected and returns already reset in July; a slight positive lean (p_up 57) from a childcare peer's Apr-Jun margin jump and a holder base that has not sold any of the last seven prints, partly offset by a hard Q1 comp, on a 1.5% scale; impact_sum +0.5 is the per-finding sum and is larger than the scaled +0.21 because the findings are each small and noisy rather than because they disagree.
bar: No quarterly bar exists: no H1 guide (kabutan finance page shows '－' for 26.06-11) and no Q1 consensus. Full-year bar: company FY27/5 OP 3,500 / 経常 3,400 / net 2,550 (決算短信 2026-07-13, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260713591892.pdf); IFIS consensus BELOW it at OP 3,247 / 経常 3,147 / net 2,108 (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=2462, 2026-10-13). Single consensus source, so sizes are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, sealed baseline). 信用倍率 2.12 (moderate margin-long, kabutan 2026-10-14). Run-up +0.2% 20d / +0.27% 5d. No options/skew. priced_lean -0.17. Nothing crowded either way.

findings.finding: Listed childcare peer JP Holdings (2749) reported Apr-Jun 2026 operating margin up from 13.2% to 15.9% and 経常 +25.6% YoY, progress 25.9% vs a 5-year average 17.9%, suggesting the FY2026 公定価格 environment is lifting childcare margins in the months overlapping LIKE's Jun-Aug Q1 (childcare is 52% of LIKE's sales).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY26 (2025-10-14, 経常 +51% YoY) rose +1.90% the next session; Q1 FY25 cadence-estimated -1.5% on a 経常 -8% print (baseline history).
findings.why_not_priced: LIKE's stock is flat over 20 and 5 days and its IFIS consensus sits 7% below the company OP plan, so the street has not marked LIKE up on the peer's margin step-up; if it had, consensus would sit at or above the plan. Proxy only: LIKE's own childcare OP fell 11.9% in FY26 on wages, food and DX spend, so transmission is unproven.
findings.independence: none — single peer document; LIKE's own FY guide (OP +17.4%) points the same way but is the company's plan, already public.

findings.finding: LIKE's measured next-session reaction to its last seven releases (Jan-2025 to Jul-2026, all released at 15:00/15:30) was 0.0, +0.84, +1.24, +1.90, +0.98, +2.05, +0.20%: never negative, including H1 FY25 with 経常 -30% and the July 2026 guide that IFIS flagged as below consensus; a 4% yield plus a 優待 programme expanded twice in April 2026 anchors a retail register that does not sell prints.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the reaction history: 7 of 7 non-negative, median +0.98%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a reaction pattern rather than information; if the market priced it away the pre-print run-in would carry it, and the 20d/5d run-up is flat. Seven events is a small sample and the benign drift could equally be market beta.
findings.independence: 株主優待制度の追加拡充 2026-04-27 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260427/140120260427511512.pdf) and dividend-policy change to 40% payout with no-cut principle 2026-07-13 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260713591900.pdf) explain the sticky holder base.

findings.finding: Q1 FY26 was flattered by an increase in 期ズレ補助金 (prior-period subsidies) booked in childcare, which lifted group OP +47.9% to 466m and makes Jun-Aug 2026 a hard comparison: a YoY OP decline in Q1 is plausible even on plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 FY25 (2025-01-14) printed 経常 -30% YoY and the stock was 0.0% next session; YoY declines have not been sold.
findings.why_not_priced: The comp is public in last year's 短信, so partly priced; what is unknown is whether a comparable 期ズレ amount recurs. A kabutan headline reading '1Q経常は減益' is what a retail reader sees first.
findings.independence: FY26 決算短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260713/140120260713591892.pdf) confirms 期ズレ補助金 lifted FY26 childcare sales; same company, different document.

findings.finding: IFIS consensus for FY27/5 (OP 3,247, 経常 3,147, net 2,108) sits 7-17% below the company plan (3,500 / 3,400 / 2,550), so the default at a Q1 — the full-year plan held — cannot disappoint the street and reads as a relief rather than a miss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: July 2026 initial guide (経常 -7%, reported as below IFIS) was +0.20% next session; no in-year revision found for this company since an April 2021 upward revision.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus unchanged for four weeks and target 1,430 below spot; a held plan is the expected outcome, so this is small. If the market believed the plan, consensus would have moved up to it.
findings.independence: kabutan finance page shows the same company plan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2462).

outside_window.finding: FY2026 (April) 公定価格/処遇改善 retroactive uplift is normally decided in December and booked as 期ズレ in LIKE's Q3/Q4; the childcare SaaS launches April 2027 and the first Indonesia nursery opens around October 2026 — none settles inside this window.

bar_hierarchy: Revision: not expected at Q1 (no in-year revisions since 2021; consensus below plan). Returns: dividend policy reset in July (40% payout, 60 yen held), 優待 expanded in April; nothing expected at Q1. New-year guide: n/a (Q1). Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q1 OP was 15.6% of FY in FY26 and 10.7% in FY25; ~525m (15%) of the 3,500 plan would be on track, against a 466m comp flattered by 期ズレ subsidies.
baseline_tension: Agrees with the flat run-up and the near-zero lean; the strongest positive the release could carry (a held plan, a buyback) was looked for — no buyback history or signal found, a held plan is the default and is included as a small positive — so the slight positive tilt is from the holder base and a peer proxy, not from a company number.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (negative on a public series -> p_up toward 50) touches only the -0.3 comp finding, whose p_up weight was already near nil at p_up 57; rule 2 (negative tilt) does not apply, one negative of four, and the strongest positive (held plan / buyback) was searched for
